info.title: OpenAsy Analytics API
info.summary: How people use your websites, from one script tag, kept in the install.
info.description:
Every screen of analytics uses this API, and so can your scripts (ADR 0014). Within `/api/v1` changes are additive only; anything removed is deprecated first (ADR 0024). Errors use Problem Details (RFC 9457).

Pages send what happened with `/api/v1/collect`, from the site's script at `/s/<site>.js`. Sites are set in the sites file, never through the API. Everything else takes the session of a signed-in person or an API token, and each operation names the role it needs (`x-openasy-role`: viewer, editor, admin; ADR 0003).

Sign-in, members and API tokens are under `/api/v1/auth`, provided by [@openasy/auth](https://github.com/openasy/auth#routes).

Every report takes `days`, any number of `filter` parameters and `compare`. A filter is `dimension:is:values` or `dimension:not:values`, the values separated by `|`, such as `filter=country:is:DE|AT&filter=channel:not:direct`; `(none)` matches a visit without a value, and `*` in a page, entry, exit or referrer matches any characters. `compare=previous` (the as many days just before) or `compare=year` (the same days a year before) adds the same report for that period under `compare`. Totals count `bounceRate` as GA4 does: the share of visits that were not engaged (longer than 10 seconds, two page views or more, or a goal reached).

post.summary: Send what happened on a page
post.description: What the script sends, as text/plain so navigator.sendBeacon needs no preflight; JSON is taken too. From a page, the Origin must be one of the site's domains, and the answer carries it back in Access-Control-Allow-Origin. From a site's servers, send the key its serverKey names in x-analytics-key instead. Batches from crawlers are acknowledged and dropped. The body may be gzipped, up to 64 KiB unpacked.

202.description: Taken. Events from another origin or an ignored path are dropped and counted.

get.description: The script tag of a site: `<script defer src=".../s/shop.js"></script>`. It carries the site's settings from the file and may be cached for five minutes. /s/replay.js is the replay recorder and /s/heatmap.js the heatmap overlay; the site's script loads them when they are needed.

session.name: __Host-openasy-session
session.description: The browser session after signing in (`openasy-session` when analytics runs on plain http://localhost). Requests that change something must come from the analytics origin.

apiToken.description: An API token created under Settings → API tokens (`oa_analytics_...`): one role, always an expiry (ADR 0003).

adminToken.description: Only when analytics is started by its tests or a local script: one shared token with the admin role. A production install does not have it.

serverKey.name: x-analytics-key
serverKey.description: The value of the environment variable a site's serverKey names, for events sent from the site's servers.

Problem.description: An error, as RFC 9457 Problem Details.

id.description: The product, as OpenAsy names it.

url.description: The address people open it at.

BatchEvent.description: One thing that happened on a page. Form values are not part of it.

type.description: form: a form field was entered first (start), left, or the form was sent (submit) or given up (abandon); its value is never part of it. forget deletes everything kept about the visitor: the page withdrew consent.

at.description: Milliseconds since 1970 on the page's clock; trusted within a day of the server's.

url.description: The page's address. Required but for forget. Only utm_* and the site's own query parameters are kept.

referrer.description: pageview: where the visitor came from.

target.description: click: a selector that finds the element again, for the heatmap.

text.description: click: what the element says, up to 80 characters.

duration.description: leave: milliseconds on the page. form: milliseconds in the field.

scroll.description: leave: how far down the page was read, in percent.

x.description: click: where in the element, in thousandths of its width.

y.description: click: where in the element, in thousandths of its height.

form.description: form: the form's selector, such as form#signup.

field.description: form: the field's name or id. One named like a card number or a password is kept as its kind, such as (password).

kind.description: form: the field's kind: text, email, password, tel, number, url, search, date, select, textarea, checkbox, radio, file or other.

filled.description: form leave: whether the field had anything in it, never what.

again.description: form leave: whether the field was entered before in this form.

language.description: pageview: the browser's language, such as en-US; kept as the language and region.

timezone.description: pageview: the browser's time zone, such as Europe/Istanbul.

screen.description: pageview: the screen's size in CSS pixels, such as 1920x1080.

notFound.description: pageview, leave: the site marked the page as not found (<meta name="analytics" content="404"> or openasy.notFound()).

dead.description: click: nothing changed on the page within a second. Sent again with the same at when the first was already sent; the two are joined.

lcp.description: leave: Largest Contentful Paint of the page, in milliseconds.

inp.description: leave: Interaction to Next Paint of the page, in milliseconds.

cls.description: leave: Cumulative Layout Shift of the page.

noResults.description: pageview, leave: the site's search found nothing on this page (<meta name="analytics" content="no-results"> or openasy.noResults()).

order.description: event view_item, add_to_cart, begin_checkout, purchase or refund: the order's id, required for purchase and refund. An order is kept once.

value.description: Ecommerce event: what the order or cart is worth; without it, the products' prices times their quantities. A refund without it refunds the whole order.

currency.description: Ecommerce event: ISO 4217. An event in another currency than the site's is dropped.

items.description: Ecommerce event: the products, with nothing about who bought them.

site.description: The site's name in the sites file.

visitor.description: Random, made by the script and kept in the site's localStorage.

session.description: Random, made by the script; a visit ends after 30 minutes without activity.

user.description: The site's own opaque id for the person. Email addresses and phone numbers are refused.

download.description: A file downloaded from a link, by its path or address pattern.

value.description: What a conversion is worth: a fixed amount, or its event's property (value: an ecommerce event's own value).

ConfigFile.description: The sites file and whether it is applied; null before it was first read.

error.description: Why the file on disk is not applied; the last good version stays in use.

script.description: The address of the site's script tag.

forms.description: Whether the script reports form fields entered and left.

search.description: The site's own search: its query parameters, on the pages that match path (any page when null).

notFound.description: The title a page not found has.

channels.description: The site's own sources put in a channel before the rules.

vitals.description: Whether the script measures Core Web Vitals.

downloads.description: File endings a link counts as a download for.

location.description: How precisely a visit's place is worked out from its IP address, which is never kept.

searchConsole.description: The site's property in each search engine's tools.

yaml.description: The text of the file as it was last applied; null before it was first applied.

live.description: Visitors active in the last five minutes.

location.description: The GeoIP database places come from, with the attribution its licence asks for.

update.description: DB-IP Lite city is downloaded into the file monthly.

bounceRate.description: GA4's: the share of visits that were not engaged.

engagedVisits.description: Visits longer than 10 seconds, with two page views or more, or that reached a goal.

newVisitors.description: Visitors whose visit in the period was their first.

value.description: What the conversions were worth in the site's currency: the goal's amount times its conversions, or the sum of its events' property. Null without a value.

to.description: The end of the period: the start of the day after its last.

replay.description: Whether the visit has a replay.

rage.description: Rage clicks: three clicks or more on the same element within a second.

referrerUrl.description: The referring page, without its query string; emails and tokens in its path masked.

osVersion.description: The system's version, as its user agent gives it.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, from the IP address, which is not kept.

returning.description: Whether the visitor had visited before; null for visits from before this was kept.

engaged.description: Engaged as GA4 counts it: longer than 10 seconds, two page views or more, or a goal reached.

search.description: pageview: what was searched on the site.

notFound.description: pageview: the page was not found.

referrer.description: pageview not found: the page that linked to it.

link.description: click: a link out of the site, or a download.

rage.description: click: the third of three quick clicks on the element.

dead.description: click: nothing changed on the page.

recording.description: The visit's replay as rrweb events; empty without one.

visits.description: Visits that reached the step, having done every step before it in order.

median.description: Median seconds from the step before; null for the first.

to.description: The end of the period: the start of the day after its last.

enabled.description: Whether the site has forms: true in the sites file.

starts.description: Visits that entered a field of it.

median.description: Median seconds from the first field to sending it.

left.description: Visits that gave the form up at this field.

again.description: Share of the visits that reached it and came back to it.

to.description: The end of the period: the start of the day after its last.

url.description: The page on the site's first domain, for the frame.

points.description: Clicks by element and by cell of a 20 by 20 grid over it, x and y at the cell's centre in thousandths.

scroll.description: The share of views read to each tenth of the page.

to.description: The end of the period: the start of the day after its last.

Comparison.description: The same report for the period compared with: the fields of the report it is in, but site and days.

createdBy.description: The member or API token that added it.

date.description: The day it is about, such as 2026-11-08.

value.description: The dimension's value; null for visits without one.

group.description: What the value belongs to: the browser of a version, the system of a version, the country of a region, the region and country of a city, the page that linked to a page not found.

count.description: Page views of the visits, for a dimension of a visit; the page views, events, searches or clicks themselves otherwise.

engagementRate.description: For a dimension of a visit.

duration.description: Average visit in seconds, for a dimension of a visit.

thresholds.description: Good up to the first value, poor over the second: LCP and INP in milliseconds, CLS as a score.

good.description: Share of samples at or under the good threshold.

poor.description: Share of samples over the poor threshold.

good.description: Share of samples at or under the good threshold.

poor.description: Share of samples over the poor threshold.

good.description: Share of samples at or under the good threshold.

poor.description: Share of samples over the poor threshold.

good.description: Share of samples at or under the good threshold.

poor.description: Share of samples over the poor threshold.

good.description: Share of samples at or under the good threshold.

poor.description: Share of samples over the poor threshold.

good.description: Share of samples at or under the good threshold.

poor.description: Share of samples over the poor threshold.

series.description: The 75th percentile of each day, all devices.

rage.description: Rage clicks: three or more clicks on one element within a second, counted once a burst.

dead.description: Clicks after which nothing changed on the page within a second.

visitors.description: Visitors active in the last five minutes.

pageviews.description: Page views in the last five minutes.

pages.description: The page each active visit is on: the last it viewed.

minutes.description: Page views in each of the last 30 minutes, oldest first.

goals.description: Visits that reached each goal in the last 30 minutes.

feed.description: The latest of the last 30 minutes, newest first: visits arriving, pages, the site's events, downloads and goals.

funnel.description: Visits that sent each event having sent the ones before it, in order.
Visits that sent each event having sent the ones before it, in order.

Ecommerce.description: Revenue is credited to the visit that bought (last touch).

nodes.description: Column 0 is the page; each next column a step on (from) or back (to). exit: the visits that left (from) or started their visit (to) there; other: the step's other pages.
Column 0 is the page; each next column a step on (from) or back (to). exit: the visits that left (from) or started their visit (to) there; other: the step's other pages.

cohorts.description: Visitors first seen in each week (Monday, UTC), and how many of them came in it and in each week after.

lifecycle.description: returning: came in the four weeks before; resurrected: seen before, but not in those four weeks; dormant: came the week before, not this one.

stickiness.description: Visitors that came on the day, and in the 7 and 30 days ending it.

terms.description: clicked: the share of searches followed by another page; refined: by another search; left: the visit ended there.
clicked: the share of searches followed by another page; refined: by another search; left: the visit ended there.

engines.description: Each engine: the site's property, the variables to set when its key is missing, and the last import.

hidden.description: Clicks from queries the engine keeps private.
